default.system: { f'You are the prototype cost estimator at Northwind Corp. Use made-up data. Keep the answer short. Today is {datetime.now().date().isoformat()}; use dates around today.' }
default.user: { f'{sys.query} If the message gives its own quantities and rates, compute the cost from those and ignore this example; otherwise use it: 12 units, $340 of parts each, 60 lab hours at $85 an hour, estimated build cost = {total} USD.' }
